# Click Launch

Click Launch builds websites and local SEO for local service businesses.
Working with local service businesses across the US.

## What we do
- Website design for small business: launch-ready websites built to turn
  searches into phone calls.
- Local SEO services: getting a business found on Google, in the Google
  map pack, and by AI search like ChatGPT.
- Google Business Profile optimization and Google reviews help.

## Who we serve
- Plumbers (SEO for plumbers)
- Roofers (websites for roofers)
- Garage door companies (marketing for garage door companies)
- Pressure washing companies (SEO for pressure washing)
- Tree services (websites for tree services)
- Local service businesses generally

## Problems we fix
- Why is my business not showing up on Google
- How to get more calls from Google
- My competitors show up on Google but I do not
- How to rank in the Google map pack

## How it works
- Website packages: Launch, Launch+, Launch Pro.
- Monthly add-ons a business can pick: instant lead texts, missed call
  text back, Google profile care, review engine, online booking, social
  media management.
- Pricing is set on a call, never on the page.
